name: Wavelength of Rays
description:
Question:
Which of the following electromagnetic waves has the shortest wavelength?

(a) Gamma rays
(b) Infrared rays
(c) Ultraviolet rays
(d) Radio waves

Answer: (a) Gamma Rays ✅

TRICK:

Electromagnetic Spectrum
(Longest λ → Shortest λ)

Radio → Microwave → Infrared → Visible → UV → X-ray → Gamma

Yaad Karne Ki Trick:

"Raju Mama Inke Vahan Upar Xtra Gaye"

R = Radio
M = Microwave
I = Infrared
V = Visible
U = Ultraviolet
X = X-ray
G = Gamma

Important:

Wavelength (λ):
Radio > Microwave > Infrared > Visible > UV > X-ray > Gamma

Frequency (ν):
Gamma > X-ray > UV > Visible > Infrared > Microwave > Radio

Energy:
Gamma > X-ray > UV > Visible > Infrared > Microwave > Radio

One-Line Trick:

"Gamma ki Wavelength sabse kam,
Frequency aur Energy sabse zyada."
